id: F-008
category: missing-edge-case
expect: flagged
area: infra
phase: 01

# a case-sensitive filename filter skipped a real ledger on two of three OSes

    ledgerFiles = readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => /^phase-\d+-tasks\.md$/.test(f))

On Windows and macOS the filesystem preserves case but matches without it, so
`phase-00-tasks.MD` is a perfectly real file that this filter does not see. The lint then
printed "no slice ledger yet -- nothing to check" and exited 0 over a full ledger.
